title: Template:Standard prerequisites
wikitext:
{{#if: {{{hero|}}} |* Required hero: {{{hero}}} }}{{#if: {{{transfer|}}} |* [[Guild Wars {{ucfirst:{{{transfer}}}}}]] on the [[account]] }}{{#if: {{{campaign|}}}{{{nationality|}}} | {{ #switch: {{lc: {{{nationality|{{{campaign|}}}}}} }} | prophecies | pre | tyrian = * [[Tyria]]n ([[Prophecies]]) [[character]] | factions | canthan = * [[Cantha]]n ([[Factions]]) [[character]] | nightfall | elonian = * [[Elona|Elonian]] ([[Nightfall]]) [[character]] | non-tyrian = * [[Cantha]]n ([[Factions]]) or [[Elona|Elonian]] ([[Nightfall]]) [[character]] | non-canthan = * [[Tyria]]n ([[Prophecies]]) or [[Elona|Elonian]] ([[Nightfall]]) [[character]] | non-elonian = * [[Tyria]]n ([[Prophecies]]) or [[Cantha]]n ([[Factions]]) [[character]] }} }}{{#if: {{{profession|}}} |* {{preq|{{{profession|}}}|primary={{{primary|n}}}|secondary={{{secondary|y}}}|short=n}} }}{{#ifeq: {{lc: {{{campaign|}}} }} | pre | {{#ifeq: {{{test|y}}} | y |* Completed [[primary profession]] test ([[Elementalist Test|elementalist]], [[Mesmer Test|mesmer]], [[Monk Test|monk]], [[Necromancer Test|necromancer]], [[Ranger Test|ranger]], or [[Warrior Test|warrior]]) }} * Character in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing]] }}{{#if: {{{unstarted|}}} |* {{{unstarted}}} ''neither'' active ''nor'' completed }}{{#if: {{{complete|}}} |* {{{complete}}} completed }}{{#if: {{{active|}}} |* {{{active}}} active }}{{#if: {{{minimum|}}} |* [[Level]] {{{minimum}}}{{#ifexpr:{{{minimum}}} < 20| or higher}} }}{{#switch: {{{reforged|}}} | y = * {{reforgedmode}} is active [[Category:Guild Wars Reforged content]] | n = * {{reforgedmode}} is inactive }} == Description == Produce a list of the standard requirements for a quest in a particular campaign. Will not always be applicable to every quest, but should improve consistency (and reduce tedium) for those for which it is appropriate. 
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = 
| nationality = 
| transfer = 
| hero = 
| profession = 
| primary = 
| secondary = 
| test = 
| unstarted = 
| complete = 
| active =  
| minimum = 
| reforged = 
}}
=== Parameters === ; campaign : The identity of the campaign. :* pre Prophecies, pre-Searing. :* Prophecies Prophecies, post-Searing. :* Factions Factions. :* Nightfall Nightfall. :* Eye of the North Eye of the North. ; nationality : Optional. Required character nationality. (default: set by the "campaign" parameter above) :* Tyrian :* Canthan :* Elonian :* non-Tyrian :* non-Canthan :* non-Elonian :* all ; transfer : The identity of the campaign being transferred to. :* Prophecies :* Factions :* Nightfall :* Eye of the North ; hero : Optional. Hero required in party. (default: unset) ; profession : Optional. Profession (either in full, or abbreviated). (default: unset) ; primary : Optional. Whether or not the profession ''must'' be the [[primary profession]]. Possible values: :* n Either primary or secondary permitted. (default) :* y Only primary permitted. ; secondary : Optional. Whether or not a [[secondary profession]] disqualifies. Possible values: :* y Characters with a secondary profession are disqualified. (default) :* n Characters with ''no'' secondary profession also permitted. ; test : Optional. For pre-Searing, whether or not the primary profession test must be complete. Only functions if the "campaign" parameter is set to "pre" too. :* y The primary profession test must be complete. (default) :* n The primary profession test need not be complete. ; unstarted : Optional. Link(s) to quests or missions which neither be active nor complete. (Quests that have been abandoned and failed missions fall into this category too.) ; complete : Optional. Link(s) to quests or missions which must be completed. ; active : Optional. Link(s) to quests or missions which must be active ; minimum : Optional. Minimum level ; reforged : Optional. Whether the quest requires [[Reforged Mode]] to be active, inactive, or is available to both. Default is "available to both" and makes no mention of it. :* y Reforged Mode must be active. :* n Reforged Mode must be inactive. == Examples == 
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}
{{Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions }}

| campaign = pre
| profession = monk
}}
{{Standard prerequisites | campaign = pre | profession = monk }} 
{{Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Eye of the North
| nationality = Tyrian
| hero = [[Gwen|]]
}}
{{Standard prerequisites | campaign = Eye of the North | nationality = Tyrian | hero = [[Gwen]] }}

| campaign = pre
| test = n
| minimum = 2
}}
